protocol: Not the full CICIDS2017 table. Every MachineLearningCSV file is streamed. A reservoir sample keeps at most 20000 BENIGN rows and 20000 attack rows (seed 42). Infinite or missing values are dropped before sampling. The sample is split 80/20 into train and test, stratified on the attack bit. CICIDS2017 has no official train/test files, so this split is defined here. Destination Port stays in the features as a number. Supervised reference. Random Forest (100 trees) is fit on the full CICIDS train sample with the attack label. A score of 0.5 is the decision threshold. This is not comparable one-to-one with the one-class models.
